subject: Platform consolidation: Outreach licensing & failover plan
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@outreach.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Outreach proposal + consolidation options

Hi Jordan / Marissa —

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation I've attached a short commercial proposal and an alternative licensing model that nets cost savings if you consolidate both SDR and AE seats onto Outreach for 24 months. Highlights:

- 18% discount off list for a 24-month commitment
- Flexible seat pool: trade AE seats into SDR seats during seasonal spikes (up to 15% of committed seats)
- Pilot fallback integration to Salesloft supported (tech integration only) for 90 days at no extra charge

I've also included a sample rollout timeline and implementation SLA. If you want, I can schedule a 30-minute exec run-through with our renewals lead next week.

Attachments: Outreach_Consolidation_Proposal_Q2.pdf, SDR_license_model_v2.xlsx

Best,
Alex Morgan
Enterprise Renewal Lead, Outreach
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outreach proposal + consolidation options

Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks Alex. Quick internal read: the numbers look promising, but I want us to avoid a hard one-vendor migration until we validate AE workflows (sequence templates, SFDC sync quirks). Proposed path:

1) Move SDR team (120 seats) to Outreach under the 24-month commit to capture the 18% discount.
2) Run a 90-day AE pilot (20 seats) on Salesloft — the pilot would be covered by the fallback terms Alex mentioned. If AE metrics match (meeting rate, reply rate within +/-10% of current), then we evaluate expanding AEs onto Outreach in a second phase.
3) Legal / Procurement: we need procurement to confirm net-payment terms (Net60 vs Net30) and SSO/KMS security addenda.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you run model A vs B (full consolidation vs split) and include tokenized cost-per-op for q3-q4? I attached the license model Alex sent — please iterate.
- Karthik: loop in GRC to get a quick assessment on the SSO/KMS requirement; if there's a blocking item we need to know before commit.
- Lauren: can you reserve $X from the FY27 ops budget for the pilot activation and any implementation professional services?

If we all agree, I'll request a formal quote with DocuSign terms and ask Alex for a definitive list of non-negotiable security clauses.

Thanks — Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outreach proposal + consolidation options

Jordan —

On it. I ran a first-pass of the spreadsheet and two scenarios stand out:

- Scenario A (Consolidate all seats): 24-month commit, estimated savings $186k vs current spend but increases implementation PS by ~30% due to AE template migration and custom SFDC field mapping.
- Scenario B (Split approach you suggested): immediate savings $110k, lower up-front PS (~$40k), preserves AE workflows during pilot.

I'll add a sensitivity tab for Net30 vs Net60 and include per-seat uplift for opt-in training and admin hours. I'll have this back by tomorrow EOD.

Also flagged a GRC note: Outreach requires an external vendor security questionnaire; I'll put the pre-filled answers in our shared Drive link and ask GRC to sign off by Apr 9.

—Marissa
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-04T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Outreach proposal + consolidation options

Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We're aligned to pursue the split approach: SDRs onto Outreach with a 24-month commit and a 90-day AE Salesloft pilot. Two quick asks before I move to procurement:

1) Can you confirm the pricing sheet for the split scenario (120 SDR seats + optional 20 AE pilot seats) and lock the 18% discount for 14 days? We need a hold window so Procurement can finish PO approvals.
2) Please send the minimal security addendum you require (SSO, SCIM, KMS notes) — GRC will validate and either redline or approve.
3) If possible, include a short clause that the AE pilot hours for implementation are cost-free if we convert AEs onto Outreach within 90 days of pilot close.

If you can get me a DocuSign-ready quote with those items and the Drive link to the SOW, I'll route to Procurement and Legal today.

Jordan Blake
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
